description: The Honda Fit Shuttle is a subcompact station wagon which was produced by Honda from May 2011 until August 2022 over two generations. The Fit Shuttle is a Japanese domestic market five-door station wagon derived from the Fit platform. The first generation served as the successor of the Airwave, which was derived from the first-generation Fit. The second generation entered production in April 2015. The Fit Shuttle has a front-mounted engine equipped with either front-wheel drive or four-wheel drive versions of petrol engined and petrol-electric hybrid variants.
